title: Chromatic Gamut
excerpt: An archived Chromatic blend, kept as a shelf note before a full tasting record was made.
body:
The old coffee list recorded Chromatic Gamut as a blend on June 22, 2025. It was marked not started, and the archive contains no brew rating or tasting notes.

I’m keeping it here as a shelf note rather than filling in a cup I never documented.

image.alt: A white Chromatic Coffee Gamut bag photographed on a kitchen counter.

title: Equator Ethiopia Fair Trade
excerpt: A washed Ethiopian coffee from Equator, preserved from the old list before it reached the brewer.
body:
This washed Ethiopian coffee from Equator entered the old list on June 22, 2025. The record says not started and does not include a rating or written tasting notes.

It belongs in the journal as an honest archive entry: a coffee I meant to explore, with the cup itself still undocumented.

image.alt: An Equator Coffees Ethiopia bag photographed before brewing.

title: Andytown Guji Kayon Mountain
excerpt: An Andytown archive record with an 8/10 Americano rating and one unresolved status mismatch.
body:
The old list records this Andytown coffee under Guji Kayon Mountain and includes an 8/10 Americano rating. The same record is marked not started, which conflicts with having a rating.

I’m preserving both details instead of quietly resolving the mismatch. No tasting notes were attached to the original entry.

image.alt: An Andytown Coffee Roasters Guji Kayon Mountain bag held in hand.

title: Fazenda Ethiopia Duram Village
excerpt: A raised-bed-dried Ethiopian coffee whose pour-over earned an archived 8/10.
body:
The archive lists this Fazenda coffee as an Ethiopian lot from Duram Village, dried on raised beds. I had it marked as currently brewing and recorded the pour-over at 8/10.

The original entry stops there, so I’m carrying the rating and process forward without inventing tasting notes that were never written down.

image.alt: A Fazenda Ethiopia Duram Village coffee bag photographed on a counter.

title: Counter Culture Field Trip
excerpt: A Counter Culture blend remembered through a strong 9/10 Americano rating.
body:
Counter Culture Field Trip appears in the old archive as a blend I was actively brewing. The one clear judgment I recorded was an Americano rating of 9/10.

There are no surviving tasting notes in that entry, so this migration keeps the high rating visible without manufacturing the flavors behind it.

image.alt: A graphic marking this entry as a coffee archive record without an original photograph.

title: Chromatic Columbia Sugarcane Decaf
excerpt: A Chromatic decaf archive entry with a 9/10 Americano rating.
body:
The legacy list names this coffee Columbia SugarCane Decaf from Chromatic. I had it marked as currently brewing and gave the Americano a 9/10.

The original record contains no written tasting notes or process details beyond the name, so I’m leaving the rest of the cup undescribed.

image.alt: A graphic marking this entry as a coffee archive record without an original photograph.

title: Chromatic Papua New Guinea Kunjin
excerpt: A finished Chromatic Kunjin record whose Americano landed at 6/10.
body:
This Chromatic coffee from Papua New Guinea was marked finished in the old archive. The Americano received a 6/10 rating.

No tasting notes survived with the record, so this entry keeps the modest score and basic provenance without trying to explain more than I originally wrote down.

image.alt: A Chromatic Papua New Guinea Kunjin coffee bag photographed on a kitchen counter.
